info.name: Souq API
info.description:
Souq mini e-commerce REST API.

Workflow: start the API -> migrate/seed -> register/login as customer, seller and admin -> create categories (admin) -> create products (seller) -> browse/filter -> cart -> order -> verify inventory -> test forbidden operations -> update order status (admin).

Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:4000) and run the Auth folder first; tokens and ids are saved automatically into collection variables.
